title: Royal Quarter
wikitext:
[[Image:Royal Quarter.jpg|thumb|Royal Quarter]]
The '''Royal Quarter''' of the [[Undercity]] contains the throne room where the Dark Lady [[Sylvanas Windrunner]], and her general the [[dreadlord]] [[Varimathras]] control their burgeoning empire of undeath.  It is protected by a squad of elite royal deathguards.  It can be found right next to the [[Apothecarium]].

This is also the home to the [[Battlemaster]]s, the NPCs who provide a means to access [[Battlegrounds]].
